result.summary: The page has a few visual/content problems: an implausible '-100%' discount badge, a truncated restaurant name in the horizontal list, and inconsistent favorite icon styling between cards.

issues.description: The discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card displays '-100%', which is confusing and likely incorrect (a -100% discount implies the item is free and the negative sign is misleading).
issues.suggestion: Verify and display the correct discount value (e.g. '20% off' or 'Up to 50% off') and avoid negative percentages unless they clearly convey a different meaning.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' in the 'Fastest near you' list is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' because the card width is too narrow.
issues.suggestion: Use text-overflow ellipsis or increase card width so long names are readable without being cut off mid-word.

issues.description: The favorite heart icon styling is inconsistent: the ramen card uses a plain outline heart while the pizza card uses a heart inside a dark circular button.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent favorite button treatment across all restaurant cards, ideally with a visible tap target/background for accessibility.
